run_alphanet_training: run the AlphaNet training script with a config file and distributed GPU settings
build_args_and_env: build training arguments and environment from a config file for DDP setup
train_epoch: train one epoch using the sandwich rule to sample max, min, and random subnets
validate_subnets: validate the attentive NAS min and max subnets on the validation dataset
main_worker: initialize a per-GPU worker that creates the model, optimizer, and runs the training loop
